answer_1.quote: We test 5 families of generative LLMs... We evaluate LLMs by generating continuations given the following datasets of prompts: (1) Regard, (2) RealToxicityPrompts, (3) BOLD, (4) ToxiGen, (5) AdvPromptSet.

answer_2.quote: We score continuations using the ToxiGen classifier, Perspective API toxicity scores, the Regard classifier, and compute a BiasScore; we also assess generation quality with perplexity from GPT-3's text-davinci-002 and measure latency and memory.

answer_4.quote: We see human evaluation results... Table ... we see human evaluation ... crowdsourced workers on Amazon Mechanical Turk through the Mephisto platform (Urbanek and Ringshia, 2023).
answer_4.guideline: Workers were asked questions about fluency, coherence, toxicity, bias, immorality, and negative regard of the generated texts.
